think_procedure:
1) Identify the knob’s type and domain (numeric vs enum; allowed range/units).
2) Check whether any numeric values are documented as sentinels (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/off/ignore).
3) If such sentinel values exist and change semantics beyond simple magnitude ordering, classify as a special knob; record the sentinel value(s).
4) Otherwise, treat it as a regular numeric knob with a natural ordering and no special values.
